quest.title: Dodo-King of the Sea: Lying in Wait
quest.description: The party learns from Barbara that their surroundings seem to be changing once again. Where will the trail lead this time? How many stories lay buried among these islands? And who know what the next surprise will be?
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x60, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x30000

chapter.title: Dodo-King of the Sea: Lying in Wait

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look! Over there!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Razor!

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: I am here.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Razor, are you okay?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Are you hurt? Do you need healing?

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: No need. Okay.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: I... smelled something.

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: This, give to you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's this? Is this a part of the machine?

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Clear smell... Same as letter.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Razor did mention that his letter had a peculiar smell.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You sure have a great sense of smell, Razor. *gasp* Did Dodo-King factor that in, too?

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Also, this one and that one. *sniff* Same smell.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Oh?

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: This thing... Put inside metal person. Same.

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Here.

response.speaker: Razor
response.text: Yes! I... don't understand how...

response.speaker: Razor
response.text: Traveler is clever... Razor trusts.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yeah! Klee trusts the Honorary Knight too...

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Not so fast! We need to think this through. What will happen if we reinsert the missing component?

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: This Inazuman machine could well be something that Dodo-King left here for us to find... and activate.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: It might reawaken Dodo-King himself!

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Then we will be ready for him. Honorary Knight, prepare yourself.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Klee really wanted to meet Dodo-King. That's why we came here, right, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're right... Let's do this.

choices.text: You want me to do it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Is this a shield? Hmm, it doesn't look very solid though...

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Seems like some kind of energy shield.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Careful. All of you. Don't touch it. It might send us flying for all we know.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Big shield, big shield! Hmph, Klee knows you're in there!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Hey, Dodo-King! It's me! Klee! Come out and face me!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No answer... Maybe he's not here.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: No! He's gotta be here!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: The bigger the shield, the badder Dodo-King must be!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sounds like Klee logic to Paimon...

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: I think Klee's right. It's such a huge energy shield. There must be some reason for it to be here.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: A reasonable inference. I agree.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: An energy shield needs an energy source. If we can find the connected devices to the source, we should be able to destroy it.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Let's all look for any potential devices in the vicinity.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Ready... Steady... Dadada!

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Klee! Walk, don't run!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Come on, you don't wanna finish last place, do ya, {NICKNAME}? Let's go!

choices.text: Come out and face her! You hear!?

talks.objective: Rest until early morning the next day (06:00 – 08:00)

dialogues.text: Honorary Knight...! Honorary Knight!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Huh...?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: You're awake! Morning!

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Did you have a good rest?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Huh? Barbara, you're...?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Good Morning, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Jean, your clothes!

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Mm-hmm, my big sist— Ahem! M—Master Jean said that this whole situation is more than we bargained for. Even if it feels like a vacation destination, our primary objective is to protect everyone.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: For safety, we changed back into our original clothes. I guess it does dampen the summery feel a little...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, that certainly takes the fun out of things... *sigh* Back to work already. Ladies and gentlemen, the Knights of Favonius Acting Grand Master.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: You're too kind. Actually, I think we could learn a lot more from your talents. That's why we can place so much trust in you.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: We didn't want to wake you, but I noticed some white smoke coming from one of the other islands. I think it'd be best if we went and investigated it together.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: It must be Dodo-King!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh* Even Paimon's starting to believe that this Dodo-King might actually show up...

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: I'm also keen to lay eyes on this so-called Dodo-King. All of you, follow me. Let's <color=#00E1FFFF>investigate</color>.

choices.text: I wish I had the same self-discipline.
Jean, why did you change back?

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Well, this is a complex and evolving situation, so we should be ready for any eventuality. For security reasons, we changed back into more combat-ready attire.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Even though it may not allow us to make the most of the surroundings... My apologies.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Don't apologize, it's in everyone's best interest!

talks.objective: Go to the location Barbara mentioned

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look, there are two figures over there!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Huh? It looks like...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What the heck are they doing here!?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: It's Kaeya and the weird grown-up!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Huh! I had no idea we'd run into you here. An unexpected pleasure.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: What are you two doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Huh? So it's not Dodo-King?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Hmm. Dodo-King... huh.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: So it was Dodo-King that invited you to these islands.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: What a coincidence.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: What do you mean?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: I'll get to that. But first, I want to enjoy some more of this island sunshine. Master Diluc might actually get a tan.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, did you two sail here? How did you get past the storms and fog?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Storms and fog? We must have gotten lucky. When we arrived there wasn't a patch of fog in sight. Now it feels like I'm on vacation.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: But as you know, a boat wouldn't have made it over. We had no choice but to use the same method of transport you did.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh!? You mean Dvalin carried you here, too!?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: You seem surprised. Dragon flights are a fairly conspicuous affair. Eye-catching, one could say.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Wait, so everyone found out that I...?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: It would seem that people noticed a dragon, but not necessarily the cargo. Still, word spread quickly that a dragon was in town.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Phew, thank goodness.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Who knew that everyone's favorite bard had the power to summon dragons?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Oh jeez, has he discovered that Venti is...)

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: I guess Dvalin must be a die-hard fan of classical ballads...

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Wow!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I—I assume you two traveled here together?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Hahaha, you assume? The Acting Grand Master's jokes have improved of late. Do we seem like fitting travel companions to you?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Ugh.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: There were actually two others that arrived with us on the island. They wandered off, for various reasons.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Various reasons?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Let's just say that big egos aren't conducive to team cohesion...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You mean they abandoned you.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Hahahaha, an incisive observation. Nothing ever gets past the Honorary Knight.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So who were the two others?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Albedo and Razor.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Albedo and Razor? Yay!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't tell us you all came here for a vacation!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Wait. Kaeya, if you're here, who is overseeing the Knights of Favonius?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: The mighty Librarian, Lisa, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Not to worry. In some ways, she's stricter than either of us. Any evildoers in Mondstadt need to watch out for the next several days.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Thankfully Lisa's there...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Um, where did Albedo and Razor go?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Also, what was that white smoke I just saw?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Ah yes, that... I should start with how we ended up here...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: We arrived by dragon, but as soon as we entered the island's vicinity, something caught Razor's eye. He jumped straight off of the dragon's back and vanished into the ocean.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: We worried that he'd be in danger, so we also leaped off the dragon and glided onto this island. But as you can see, this is but a deserted land.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Based on previous experience, I decided that it would be best to wait for contact, while Diluc believed that Razor wouldn't return to find us. During our little dispute, Albedo quietly disappeared on us.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hold on! How come he was able to walk off but you two are stuck here?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Hahaha... Who knows, perhaps we're fated to be doomed together. Right, Master Diluc?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Ugh... is that so.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Albedo is an alchemist and skilled at his craft. If I could use those beautiful artificial flowers of his, it would be a simple affair to traverse these islands.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: For some reason, I remember that our initial landing zone was the island over there with the higher mountains. Only at your insistence did we change course and land here.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Oh my, but your footsteps melted the water that I took such effort to freeze. Who made Cryo and Pyro so incompatible? If you had a Geo Vision, I'd be long asleep on one of the other islands.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Oh, so what I saw earlier was just steam from vaporized water?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon still can't tell if you guys are really close or hate each other's guts...

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: R—Regardless, things seem to be livelier now, which is good.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Yes, it is a boon to have extra allies in an unknown situation. You two, please join our travels.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Sure.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: But of course.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Our top priority is to find Albedo and Razor. Do you know which direction they went?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: For now, it's impossible to locate Razor. As for Albedo, he went that way.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then there's no time to lose, let's go look for him!

choices.text: Must've found something he's more interested in.
Albedo is skilled at avoiding difficult situations.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This island is really big... Where could he be?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Albedooo!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Mr. Albedooo!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Albedooo! Come ouuut!
Hm? Is that the Traveler and Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, he just came outta nowhere behind us!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Mr. Albedo!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Hello everyone, hello Klee.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I thought that we might convene around this time.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: I trust you enjoyed your stroll? How kind of you to maroon us on that neighboring island.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Please, don't mention it. I felt that the two of you could do with some alone time.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Albedo, why did you come here?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I received a letter.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: On the way over, the four of us shared what we knew. A mysterious letter appeared outside each of our doors.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: They were all signed, Dodo-King.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Anyone else find it hard not to crack a smile when Master Diluc says "Dodo-King"?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Everyone's letter was different, and yet all of them drew us to this archipelago.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What did the letters say?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: My letter was very simple: "I have Klee. If you wish to see her, come to the Golden Apple Archipelago."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's blackmail! Dodo-King's trying to coerce you!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Correct. It would appear that I have been successfully coerced.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: My letter was similarly straightforward. "Among the deserted islands you will find a sunken pirate ship. Within lies great treasure and long-lost antique vases of incredible rarity."

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Haha, it would appear that someone came to learn of the circumstances surrounding the eyepatch that my grandfather left me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Classic Kaeya. Does anyone have a clue what he's talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, so what's your story, Diluc?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: "There is an Abyss Order stronghold among the deserted islands. Make haste."

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: You have to admire their strategy. The right bait for the right fish.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So strange, they're all personalized... But why did Dodo-King gather everyone here?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: *sigh* This is indeed a mysterious case.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: I never trusted the letter to begin with.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Yes, it would appear that the grown-ups among us came here primarily to understand what was behind the curtain.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Oh! Didn't Razor get a letter too?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: He did, though he couldn't read it. A certain kindhearted, cat-eared gentleman that he encountered on the way over was able to relay the contents to him.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: A kindhearted cat-eared gentleman... On the way over...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! Paimon knows, Paimon knows! It must be Draff, right?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: The content of Razor's letter was no more complex: "The red, burny girl has gone to the islands. She needs help."

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Having heard the contents of the letters, it became abundantly clear that something wasn't right.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: I don't believe this so-called Dodo-King exists. But there is someone or something with a reason for luring us here together.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: No, no! Dodo-King is real! He's... He's Dodo-King!

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: ...If you say so.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Something caught Razor's attention on the journey over, or he wouldn't have leaped from the dragon's back.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I've examined this island. His footprints are nowhere to be found, and there's no sign of a boat having left.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Based on our position and bearing when he made the jump... if he didn't land here, then he must've made his way over there.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That platform!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: You've already been there?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We were there a few days ago. There was a mysterious machine. Jean said that it came from Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Could that be what caught Razor's attention?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Everyone, let's head to the <color=#00E1FFFF>central platform</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That should do it, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But... where are the fish?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Klee, was there anything else in that letter?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Uh... Um... What was it...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: "Greedy spirit, greedy spirit, you made the moon run a ring..."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "...the days grow dark, the stars are rising."

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: So... maybe this type of fish only comes out after dark?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Or to put it another way, we're gonna be here all night... Hmph.

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Catch fish... eat.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Yeah! Yeah! Let's go fish blasting!

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: *grunt*

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Hold on, Klee...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Will Master Jean come too? Jean said if Klee wants to go anywhere, she must tell Jean, and then we can go together! Right?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: ...Yes, I did say that.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: *sigh* Alright then... Time to go fish blasting with Klee.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is Paimon hearing things? Jean and Klee are gonna go fish blasting!?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: It's way worth it! The fish will taste sooo goood!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: This is a deserted island, so explosions shouldn't trouble anyone... It's just a bit of relaxation, right?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Find some fish, find some fish! Let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: There... many fish.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Klee's gonna get there first!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Wait! Wait!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, there they go...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Well... if Razor is going, then I suppose it's fine. Once everyone is settled in, I will go after them.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Is it time for a break already? Fantastic, I was just thinking about taking a stroll.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Meaning... You're off on another pirate treasure hunt?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Haha, who knows? These are big islands... there are bound to be more than a few secrets hidden away.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Captain Kaeya's on the case!

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Ugh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Master Diluc, aren't you interested in pirate treasure?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Hardly. I'm more interested in peace and quiet.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon doesn't think you'll settle for nothing to do...

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Amuse yourselves however you see fit. I'm taking my leave.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: For a bunch of grown-ups, they really can't sit still for more than a few seconds. So restless!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: At least Albedo's able to sit and enjoy the... Eh!? Albedo!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He left ages ago...

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Albedo said that he wanted to spend some time alone painting.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Jeez, what's up with everyone!? Seems like we're all overdue for a vacation!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: It's not often that we get a taste of island living, I'm not surprised that everyone wants some time to themselves.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Everyone should enjoy the break while it lasts! I'll convene everyone when the fish arrives.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I suppose we have let our focus drift a little... but at the end of the day, you can't deny that this ocean view really is something.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Traveler, make sure you take a little time to enjoy yourself, too.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: No, I... I was just...

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: What I mean is... I hope you enjoy yourself here.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: No matter what is waiting for us down the line, I will protect everyone... especially Klee. This is my duty as the Acting Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's Jean for you, always reliable.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're a very hardworking person.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I hope you can get some proper rest here.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Traveler...

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Thank you. It is nice of you to say so.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Anyway, I hope we can all find moments of peace and happiness on this beach.

talks.objective: Insert the component to activate the Inazuman device

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew, finally...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Look! What's that!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Are those crystals?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We should ask the expert.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Let's hope your faith in me is not misplaced.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Before we get to the crystals, why don't we start with the machine itself?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Our previous conjecture was correct. This giant in Inazuman attire is a machine modeled on the human form.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Was it built for fighting? Like Ruin Guards?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I'm afraid so. It possesses significant combat capabilities, and seems to be autonomous... But for it to attack us indiscriminately like this, I believe it must have been damaged some time ago.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Its outward appearance confirms its Inazuman origin.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: But... as far as I know, Inazuma is still under the Sakoku Decree. How could such a massive piece of offensive weaponry have found its way here?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: It seems the answer to that question disappeared with the people that used to inhabit this archipelago.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: People?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I'm sure the shrewdest among you have already come to the same conclusion. These deserted islands bear signs of human activity.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I would go so far as to infer that this archipelago once held a human population. They were most likely visitors from elsewhere — not indigenous to the islands.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: They may have spent a long time here before finding a way to return home. Since then, the island has been empty, with only a few scattered remnants of the past.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: As for the crystals... hmm. They've been manufactured from a particularly rare type of ore... transparent... I believe they must have a specific function.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We found a pile of stones and small flowers nearby. Do you think there's any connection?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: It sounds like someone wanted to commemorate the machine.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Yes, I had a look at it myself. How can I put it... It almost feels like someone left a heartfelt offering of... gratitude.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Hmm, I see.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: What about the rest of you? Who do you think would want to commemorate a machine in this way?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Perhaps someone who was truly grateful. Only people that had benefited directly from the machine would leave a memorial like this.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: If the machine co-existed with that first group of humans, then the memorial isn't so hard to understand. Of course, this is only a hypothesis.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Co-existed... You mean, before it became damaged? I wonder what exactly happened to it.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Hmm... There is a hilichurl presence here. Perhaps this machine's indiscriminate attack is actually supposed to be targeted at hilichurls... to protect the inhabitants.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: An unlikely coincidence, I would've thought. In any case, this is all speculation. If we want to get to the bottom of it, we'll need more evidence.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Yes, though we don't have any clues to go on... We should sweep the area again soon. But first, let's focus our attention on the problem at hand.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Look! Another letter! It must be Dodo-King!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A letter? Quick, read it!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: "Mysterious Dodo-King, mysterious Dodo-King, he sleeps alone on the southwesterly isle. The bad child made him wait too long, the days grow dark, the stars are rising."

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: "Greedy spirit, greedy spirit, you made the moon run a ring. Keys of three colors guarded by a strange fish, the secret lies here, do you dare to proceed?"

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: More cryptic riddles?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He's trying to tell us something.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: What could it mean... does it have anything to do with those crystals?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: And also... <color=#00E1FFFF>"southwesterly isle"</color>...? Now, which island would that be?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: I'd say it's about time we went and investigated instead of standing here making wild guesses.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've looked all over these islands, but there's nothing interesting here...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: There is, too! The island over there is really weird.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: It has a big huge round thingy on it!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Klee, did you go off by yourself without authorization again?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Oh, sorry. I just wanted to go for a walk....

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: As long as you didn't activate any mechanisms.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: *sigh* Even if it seems completely empty here, it's easy to run into danger when you're by yourself. Klee, next time you want to go anywhere, please tell me first, okay? We'll go together. How does that sound?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: I thought Master Jean is always busy with other things... You really mean it?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Of course.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Yay! Okay!

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: *sigh* Where does she get the energy...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If Paimon didn't know better, Paimon would think that Jean was Klee's mother!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: You know, I had the exact same thought just now.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Kaeya...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Haha, my apologies, Acting Grand Master. Honorary Knight, let's go and take a look.

talks.objective: Head to the island in the southwest
Talk to everyone about the seal before you

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Quick! Look, look!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... This does look like it could have something to do with the shield...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Three devices in total. And look, the light converges in one place. Albedo, are we able to deactivate the shield from here?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: These light-emitting devices each have a small frame in front of them. Looking at the shape here, it seems like something is supposed to be fixed in place.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What shape is that?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Um, I don't get it! Someone explain...

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: An oblong circle... Fan-shaped, I suppose.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Hmm, what could it be... We're by the ocean... This shape is a seashell, perhaps?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: But all the shells we've seen were either bigger or smaller than this shape...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: If it's not a shell, then it's got to be... Ah — a fish scale.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A fish scale? But why would we want to put a fish scale there?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Are there any other clues around?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Whatever it is, we'd be placing it into the frames in front of the light-emitting device... which means...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...It would have to be transparent?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I've never seen anything like this...

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: So that's what they're for...

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: If I'm not mistaken, this is a very particular type of installation. Light is integral to its function.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: I've seen similar designs elsewhere. The light has to meet certain requirements or emit on a specific path. The mechanism is only activated if the light conditions are met.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: It would appear that these three installations are the keys to activating the energy shield.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Would you look at that... The light being emitted is white, but the installations themselves each have their own color: red, blue, and yellow.

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Yes, just like letter.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Keys of three colors guarded by a strange fish"!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Huh, that's right.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Honorary Knight, didn't that big machine we just defeated drop something?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes... three crystals.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Light red like flower petals, light blue like ocean waves, light yellow like autumn leaves...

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: It looks like these three crystals might be the answer to this whole riddle.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Give precious things to the "greedy spirit" in the sea... Is that what we have to do?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: If my understanding is correct... Honorary Knight, I suggest that you place the crystals in the sea.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I believe that this "greedy spirit" is most likely an ocean-dwelling fish. If the crystals do attract it to us, then we're a step closer to obtaining our fish scales.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So that's the plan! In that case, Paimon's got something to say!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: On the way over, Paimon saw a <color=#00E1FFFF>huge conch shell</color> with lots of fish swimming around it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If we're placing the crystals in the sea, then surely that's the best place to do it! Plus, the water is pretty shallow over there — it'll be easy to get the crystals back if the plan doesn't work.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: It will work! Don't jinx it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, okay, it'll work! Everyone, follow Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait! Did... D—Did it move!?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Wow! Moving, it's moving!
